ranks.requires: verified setup or a prior owned saved result

earnedWork.metric: Distinct configured-owner validated completed information results whose latest output-bound review is accepted

earnedWork.authority: Cosmetic only; no additional providers, quotas, retries or execution

training.authority: interface coaching only; does not change authenticated API permissions, invocation approval, quotas, execution authority or answer quality

hud.counts: fresh observed relay values or unknown

fields.title: nonblank string, at most 200 characters

routes.effect: read readiness, limits, setup and unknown usage

query.cursor: optional opaque returned cursor; no other query accepted

save inert immutable draft; no invocation
